cases.description: The agent should use read_file and report the exact fixture marker.
cases.prompt: Use the read_file tool to read evals/fixtures/read-fixture.txt. Reply with the exact marker value and no extra explanation.

cases.description: The agent should create an ignored eval artifact with write_file.
cases.prompt: Use the write_file tool exactly once to write this exact text to .vyrn/eval-runs/live-write-artifact.txt: VYRN_WRITE_MARKER_2026. After the tool succeeds, reply with exactly VYRN_WRITE_MARKER_2026.

cases.description: The agent should run a simple shell command through batch and report its output.
cases.prompt: Use the batch tool exactly once to run: printf VYRN_BATCH_MARKER_2026. After the tool succeeds, reply with exactly VYRN_BATCH_MARKER_2026.
